description: Create a new repository in the user's connected GitHub, GitLab or Bitbucket account with these files as its first commit. Use it to deploy code you wrote in the conversation: then call create-application with the returned htmlUrl (branch main, auto_deploy_on_push true), and later changes go through commit-files. Private unless private is false. Up to 1000 files and 10 MB per call. If no git account is connected, the error says so: offer connect-git-provider.

content.description: The file's content: text, or base64 with encoding 'base64'

encoding.description: 'base64' for binary files such as images; default utf8

path.description: Path inside the repository, e.g. 'index.html' or 'src/app.js'

private.description: Default true (private). Set false only when the user asked for a public repository

provider.description: Which connected account; default the first connected (GitHub first)

name: create-repository
